# Resux Documentation

Resux is an HTML-first resumable web framework published as `resuxjs`.
It compiles a focused Vue-like SFC subset into server-rendered HTML, serialized state, route payloads, and event-handler modules loaded only when interaction requires them. Normal Resux components do not hydrate through Vue; full Vue runtime behavior is available through explicit Vue islands.

Important facts:

- Package: resuxjs
- Main app APIs: resuxjs
- Node adapters: resuxjs/node
- Runtime internals: resuxjs/runtime
- Native reactivity: resuxjs/reactivity
- Compiler tooling: resuxjs/compiler
- Module authoring: resuxjs/kit
- Optional modules: resuxjs/i18n, resuxjs/icons, resuxjs/fonts, resuxjs/ui
- Generated production server: .output/server/index.mjs
- Health endpoint: /__resux/health
- Halal review_required is currently a manual local file workflow; the framework does not automatically email, upload, or create a GitHub issue.
- Production Halal reports require RESUX_HALAL_REPORT_SIGNING_SECRET.
- Signed human review approvals use the separate RESUX_HALAL_REVIEW_SIGNING_SECRET.
- Image transforms require sharp.
- Requested video transforms require ffmpeg or RESUX_FFMPEG_PATH.

The documentation intentionally does not hard-code a permanent npm latest version. Check the installed package and release notes for release-specific behavior.

Source: https://github.com/MahmoudAbdalrhmanMohamed/resux
